description:
Once htgr_sim_v1's crates/outram-park-digital-twin-engine/examples/htgr_sim_v1/physics/reactor_model/one_node.rs::PebbleBedPorousMediaNode is tested and human-V&V'd (per the crate CLAUDE.md's example-to-library promotion trigger, op-76hu), it should be promoted from example code into the outram-park-digital-twin-engine library proper (src/), the same standard applied to every example model/widget per that trigger.

PebbleBedPorousMediaNode is a one-node, two-temperature (solid pebble + fluid helium) porous-media LTNE energy balance, discretized backward-Euler and solved each step as a 2x2 linear system via outram_foam_basic_lib::matrix::square_matrix::SquareMatrix. It gives the helium its own thermal capacitance/node (upgrading it from the "0 nodes, external" treatment PebbleBedCore's effectiveness-NTU balance uses), taking fission_power and decay_heat_power as separate arguments summed into one source term.

Follow-up work (deferred, not started):
1. Add a molten-salt variant of the same two-node implicit formulation for FHR (fhr_sim_v2's PebbleBedThermalHydraulics equivalent) -- same 2x2 backward-Euler structure, salt properties (OPCPFluidArray/molten-salt EOS) instead of helium.
2. Once both variants exist in the library, wire them to drive both htgr_sim_v1 (gas-cooled) and fhr_sim_v2 (salt-cooled), replacing each simulator's own example-local core model.
3. Human V&V required before promotion per RESPONSIBLE_USE.md -- AI-assisted output is untrusted draft material until reviewed; the existing tests (two_node_balance_settles_with_all_power_leaving_via_helium_throughflow, fission_power_and_decay_heat_power_sum_into_the_same_source_term) check energy-conservation identities only, not accuracy of the well-mixed-outlet assumption or T_pebble/T_helium against any published reference.

Origin: user request 2026-08-17, "Once this is tested, it should be put inside the outram-park-digital-twin-engine library, with a salt variant too for FHR. Then it should drive both htgr_sim_v1 and fhr_sim_v2."
title: Promote PebbleBedPorousMediaNode (implicit 2-node LTNE porous-media balance) into the library, add a molten-salt variant, drive both htgr_sim_v1 and fhr_sim_v2
